C1124.title: Gemini AI Weaponized as PhaaS: The Industrial Evolution of Intelligent Phishing Attacks
C1124.summary: Cybercriminals bypassed Google Gemini's safety guardrails to deeply embed large model capabilities into the full PhaaS (Phishing-as-a-Service) chain.
